Hi1.first_notes: d_a_npc_hi1.cpp is effectively fully decompiled - the single '/* Nonmatching */' marker sits at the tail of _draw (line 843), after the return, and does not hide any logic. Like Jabun, the King of Hyrule has NO actor-side dialogue: getMsg_HI1_0() returns 0, getMsg() forwards that, and next_msgStatus() returns fopMsgStts_MSG_ENDS_e unconditionally (d_a_npc_hi1.cpp:398-418). Both of its data tables are placeholders - l_evn_tbl[1] = {"dummy"} and privateCut's a_cut_tbl[1] = {"DUMMY"} - which means even the event-cut plumbing is a stub with no named actions. The King's whole 'true identity of the boat' scene is authored in event data. 'first' is empty for that reason, not for lack of reading. What IS solid here: archive/model/anims/joints, an attention point 270.0f above current.pos, attention flags LOCKON_TALK|ACTION_SPEAK, and the dist_table index 0xA9 written to BOTH distances[TALK] and distances[SPEAK].
Hi1.notes: look_limits_deg is read from daNpc_Hi1_HIO_c's a_prm_tbl (d_a_npc_hi1.cpp:47-58) and fed into m_jnt.setParam every frame in _execute. Raw s16 values: mMaxHeadY 0x1FFE, mMinHeadY 0xE002 (-0x1FFE), mMaxHeadX 0x0000, mMinHeadX 0xF600 (-0x0A00), mMaxBackboneY 0x0744, mMinBackboneY 0xF8BC (-0x0744), mMaxBackboneX 0x0000, mMinBackboneX 0xF9DA (-0x0626), mMaxTurnStep 0x0258. So the King can turn his head a full 45 degrees sideways but only tilt it down (never up), and his torso barely moves. Collision cylinder is set every frame at radius 110 / height 260.

Tc.first_notes: type4, Windfall jail. Tingle starts sitting on the Ostool; the first time the player comes within 900 units he plays the TC_JUMP_DEMO cutscene (no text), lands and walks to the cell bars. The first talk there is not a plain talk at all - statusWalkToJail orders the TC_TALK_NEAR_JAIL event (TC_TALK_NEAR_JAIL_S instead when clearCount != 0) and sets UNK_0B40. That event's TALK_MSG is 4301 'Hmmmmmm! I see the same green clothes ... could you, by chance, be...a fairy?' and next_msgStatusNormal walks 4301->4302->4303->4304->4305->4306 'Please, Mr. Fairy... Rescue poor Tingle from this place'. Further talks in the SAME room visit fall through to getMsgNormal, which with UNK_0B40 already set gives 4313 'If you help me, I will give you a fabulous present!' -> 4312. Re-entering the jail replays the shorter TC_TALK_NEAR_JAIL2 cutscene from 4308 'Why! If it isn't Mr. Fairy! Do you remember poor Tingle?'. getMsgNormal's !UNK_0B40 branch (4307->4306) is effectively unreachable in retail because statusWalkToJail sets UNK_0B40 and mHasTalkedNearJail together.
